text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet's challenge in the Twinkle 
Series. Her destructive and dazzling 
chronicle of battles drew to a close――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, an end is merely a beginning. Just as 
destruction and rebirth continue in 
endless rotation, her journey will become 
a myth, beginning anew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To destroy the destined path of every 
Umamusume with that running, and show them 
true chaos and possibility——"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One night, I found a note in the 
Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written there... was simply, "Where the 
primordial flame is kindled"...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――It seems that was a bit too easy for the 
current you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Looking at you, it seems 
deduction wasn't even necessary.
choice_data_list:
...Honestly, this was the only place that 
came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the words "Igniting Spark," the 
very first place that came to mind was 
this training track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was here that Tanino Gimlet once saw my 
talent—the talent to become utterly 
intoxicated by her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can recall the exhilaration of that 
moment as if it were yesterday. Thus, the 
instant it crossed my mind, my legs 
naturally carried me forward—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Knowing you, I expected you to arrive 
here as fast as possible. Therefore――――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Right on time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as darkness suddenly enveloped my 
field of vision—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All the lights on the track had gone out. 
I hadn't realized it, but it was already 
lights-out time...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The path I have walked up to this day... 
It is one I never could have paved on my 
own.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The one-and-only soul who shared my 
ambition, was intoxicated by me more than 
anyone else, and stood by me with utter 
madness...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—My brethren of chaos. It was because you 
were there that I became the "God of 
Destruction."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, beneath the watching stars, I 
shall praise you just as you are.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When you chose me. When you resolved to 
protect me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When you told me you would let yourself go 
mad for my sake. When remorse overflowed 
from your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When you reached out to me once again. 
When you showed your resolve to the 
observers.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All of that―――― broke the chains of 
destiny entwining me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...You were a peculiar existence from the 
start. Cycles, fate, destiny—I could not 
feel a single trace of them from you...――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet, along the way, I realized. You... 
stand outside of all such things. A being 
who arrived from beyond the bounds of 
fate.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And precisely because you're an outlier... 
you shamelessly and mercilessly destroyed 
my script.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It was destroyed, only to be reborn in an 
even more magnificent form.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? Trainer. The true "God 
of Destruction" is—you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You are the one and only———— irreplaceable 
"God of Destruction" to Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To my beloved 'Goddess of Destruction,' I 
dedicate this supreme drink tonight.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...It really is wonderful, you know. 
Having a drink in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Immoral————and utterly catastrophic.
choice_data_list: It is... so incredibly—beautiful, isn't it

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about the past and the future, I 
slowly savored the drink Tanino Gimlet had 
crafted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――"Someday, we will toast beneath the 
starry sky again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It became a special phrase that existed 
only between Tanino Gimlet and myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And night turned to dawn, the sun rose, 
night came again—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Repeating countless mornings and 
nights————

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――All living things search for the meaning 
of their birth.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And at times, they find meaning in it, as 
providence, fate, and destiny—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...The reason I was born into this world. 
Surely today is one of the biggest reasons 
for that."
choice_data_list: I'll see it through to the end, with you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Just watch me from "there."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The meaning of why we... were born into 
this world.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like everything is in order, Kris 
S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...To remain unchanged. That is 
what...――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
To meet your challenge head-on—that is my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. ...I am truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, as I prepare to welcome 
him— my passion only burns that much 
hotter...!!
—Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Today, I will challenge you with 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"My running... I swear I'll etch it into 
your mind!!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: LOOKING FORWARD TO WORKING WITH YOU!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Impressive.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yes. It is truly————beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (......I was having a dream.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since before we were even born, I'm 
sure— we were meant to face off like 
this...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, my destiny. My recurring fate. The 
promised time has come...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us show this world, to the fullest, 
what it means for us to run together!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Because it's far too early for us to part 
ways—
